source: TaxCalcBench (Column Tax) — agent configurations on the same 31 held-out TY2024 cases (the common set all four completed). Harnesses via cli-bridge, raw+steered via router.
note: Same 31 cases for every bar (the intersection all four configs completed). Two honesty caveats: (1) each config runs a DIFFERENT base model (codex=gpt-5.5, claude-code=sonnet, raw/steered=gpt-5.6), so this ranks agent CONFIGURATIONS, not a controlled harness-vs-raw ablation. (2) At frontier level everything sits 90-95% with fully OVERLAPPING CIs — statistically indistinguishable. The large tools-beat-raw gap only appears against WEAKER base models (see the raw-models board: gpt-5.1 66, haiku 58); a strong raw model is already near ceiling, so tools/steering add little.
